# live2d-web

> A Live2D runtime for the modern web: model loading, motions, pointer
> tracking, tap hit testing, lip sync and render quality, from vanilla
> JavaScript or React, with a direct WebGL2 backend and no PixiJS dependency.

live2d-web is an unofficial third-party library, not affiliated with Live2D
Inc. Applications built with it may need their own Live2D Cubism SDK license
(https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/license/). The package does not bundle Cubism
Core or any model; both are supplied by the application.

Install: `npm install live2d-web`. Entry points: `live2d-web` (vanilla,
React-free), `live2d-web/react` (components and hooks),
`live2d-web/adapters/cubism-webgl` (default backend),
`live2d-web/adapters/pixi-v6` (compatibility backend). TypeScript definitions
with JSDoc ship with the package.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Heonys/live2d-web#readme): full guide with
  runnable examples for every feature (motions, taps, lip sync, parameters,
  quality, errors) plus React reference tables
- [API reference](https://github.com/Heonys/live2d-web/blob/main/docs/api-design.md):
  complete signatures and per-frame contracts
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/live2d-web): install page with a
  condensed API tour

## Demo

- [React playground](/): motions, expressions, tap hit testing, microphone
  lip sync
- [Vanilla playground](/vanilla): the same runtime driven with createLive2D()
- [Model inspector](/inspect): load any model3.json URL and probe its motions,
  expressions and parameters
- [Backend comparison](/compare): the WebGL2 backend next to the Pixi v6
  compatibility backend
